title: Strict truncation inclusions with their tensor components
statement: For $J,O,\ell,B_n$ and the strict semilinear coefficient systems as in [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension], fix ordinary extension adjunctions $E_n\dashv e_n$ with their normalized below-level tensor comparisons and their zero components above the extension level. Fix a normalized ordinary quotient tensor associator [lem-pur-coefficient-tensor-ordinary-coherence]. For every $n\leq m$ there is a natural transformation $s_{mn}:T_{mn}E_n\to E_m$. Its evaluated component at $q\leq n$, conjugated by the two below-level comparisons, is the tensor associator $T_{mn}T_{nq}\cong T_{mq}$. At $q>n$ its evaluated component is zero. Its transpose under $E_n\dashv e_n$ is the inverse below-level comparison $E_me_n\cong T_{mn}$.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: Transpose the inverse below-level comparison E_m e_n to T_mn under E_n left adjoint to e_n. Naturality of the Hom bijection gives a transformation T_mn E_n to E_m.

Below n transpose the component twice by scalar adjunctions. The ordinary extension Hom formula identifies this with two strict transitions applied to the m-level adjunction unit. Their composition law replaces them by the direct transition. The normalized tensor associator has the same value on successive scalar-extension units. Injectivity of the two Hom bijections gives equality. Above n the source is zero.

theorem coefficientEvaluationStrictSigma
    (ordinary : CoefficientOrdinaryEvaluationData (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell))
    (assoc : ∀ {l m n : ℕ} (h₁ : m ≤ l) (h₂ : n ≤ m),
      coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) h₁ ⋙
        coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) h₂ ≅
        coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) (h₂.trans h₁))
    (ha : CoefficientTensorAssocNormalized assoc) :
    ∃ sigma : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) h ⋙ ordinary.extension n ⟶
        ordinary.extension m,
      (∀ {m n q : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (hq : q ≤ n) F,
        (ordinary.below hq).inv.app ((coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) h).obj F) ≫
          (coefficientEvaluation (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) q).map ((sigma h).app F) ≫
          (ordinary.below (hq.trans h)).hom.app F = (assoc h hq).hom.app F) ∧
      (∀ {m n q : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (_hq : n < q) F,
        (coefficientEvaluation (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) q).map ((sigma h).app F) = 0) ∧
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) F,
        (ordinary.adj n).homEquiv _ _ ((sigma h).app F) =
          (ordinary.below h).inv.app F)
